login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access for professionals. No passwords.
login.intro: Enter your email and we will send you an access link.
login.emailHint: Single use. No password to create or remember.
login.sendingSlow: One moment: we are preparing your link. It can take a few seconds.
login.linkSent: We sent an access link to {{email}}. Check your inbox.
login.error: We could not send the link. Try again.

callback.title: Completing access
callback.error: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
callback.errorGeneric: We could not complete access. Try again in a moment.
callback.emailIntro: You opened the link in another browser or tab, so we need the address we sent it to.
callback.emailHint: The same address that received the link.
callback.emailMismatch: That address does not match the link. Check it and try again.

denied.title: You can't enter Nox
denied.body: This account does not have access.
